name: overcode
description: Extends the AIDD framework with project-agnostic workflows: memory maintenance (harvest, reconcile-normative), obsolescence detection (taste), prospective analysis (foresee), behavioural-test harness for prompts (behave), test-suite governance by density and declared phase (control, user-invoked only), performance audits (data-optimize, web-optimize, ap-optimize), SEO/GEO audits (seo-optimize), project health reporting (status), plain-language explanations (baby), documentation (readme, changelog), and planning utilities (decompose, journey). Stack knowledge is never hardcoded: audits load pivots dropped by the sc-* plugins under .claude/rules/07-quality/. Alias chains: rechallenge, endtask, bump-plugin, previously, smarten, skillconf, weeklyemail, gitit, mirror, codex-vision.
